column1: # School holidays of Berlin, first and last day of each holiday (KMK convention: both days are holidays).
# Source: Kultusministerkonferenz, "Ferien im Schuljahr 2022/2023", "2023/2024", "2024/2025", "2025/2026", row Berlin,
#   (copies in raw/); retrieved 2026-10-01. Read from the one-page tables; the single days of the column "Himmelfahrt/Pfingsten" and
#   the single autumn days (2.10.2023, 4.10.2024) are bridge days, named bridge_day. Berlin has a winter holiday of one week in February.
# The "bewegliche Ferientage" of individual schools are not in the file. Summer 2026 (09.07.-22.08.2026) lies after the horizon and is left out.
# The layout of the tables has the Berlin entries on several lines; the dates were checked against the Brandenburg row next to them.
